Q1_decision_rule.note: a NEW Phase 9 rule; does not modify Phase 8's frozen point-estimate stopping rule

per_model.IN_BAND: 0.25 <= L_m and U_m <= 0.70 (entire 95% CI inside the band)
per_model.UNRESOLVED: none of the above (CI straddles a band edge)

Q2_decision_rule.detected: model m shows a detected label effect at F3 iff its 95% CI for Delta_m excludes 0
Q2_decision_rule.interval: the same uniform S1f interval (no effect-size-dependent switching)

analysis_implementation.requirement: the analysis code run after execution MUST be hash-identical to this value

estimands.Q1_theta_m: (1/8) * sum_{d=1..8} mu_d ; mu_d = E_{s~G_d}[pi_m(s) | N, F3] (fixed constant)
estimands.inferential_target: Option B -- fixed-domain synthetic superpopulation; the 8 domains are fixed strata, scenarios are draws from the frozen generator G_d
estimands.per_model: each of the 4 models analysed separately; never pooled

multiplicity: four Delta_m contrasts are separately motivated; no union claim, no required FWER correction; Holm-adjusted p-values reported supplementary-only; Q1 and Q2 are separate families

point_estimators.theta_hat_m: (1/8) * sum_d ybar_{d,N}  (ybar_{d,N} = mean of domain d's N rates)

primary_interval.formula_var: Vhat = (1/64) sum_{d=1..8} max(s2_d, f_d) / n   (n = scenarios per domain; s2_d = ddof-1 sample variance of domain d)
primary_interval.method: S1f -- fixed-stratum Welch-Satterthwaite t on the within-domain scenario variance, with a per-domain binomial-derived variance floor
primary_interval.q2_uniformity: uniform S1f at every observed effect size -- no transform, no inflation, no data-dependent method switch
primary_interval.support_clip: Q2 interval clipped to [-1, 1]; Q1 interval clipped to [0, 1]
primary_interval.t_quantile: stdlib Student-t quantile via the regularized incomplete beta (scripts/phase_9_design_simulation.py)
primary_interval.variance_floor_Q2: f_d = ( pbar_{N,d}(1 - pbar_{N,d}) + pbar_{P,d}(1 - pbar_{P,d}) ) / R
primary_interval.welch_satterthwaite_df: nu = Vhat^2 / sum_d ( u_d^2 / (n - 1) ) ,  u_d = max(s2_d, f_d) / (n * 64)

sensitivity_analyses_only: method G (domain-level t, df = 7) -- demoted; over-covers the fixed-domain estimand
raw stratified WS-t without the floor (method S1)
studentized fixed-stratum scenario bootstrap, domains fixed (method S2)
trial-level Wilson interval on pooled N trials
binomial GLMM with a scenario random intercept (sole source of any odds ratio)
atanh-scale S1f for Q2 (retained only as a labelled sensitivity comparison)
attrition: protocol-error trials excluded from numerator and denominator
